family_title_en: Segment two-syllable words: silent e, vowel team, r-controlled

stages.ix_title: Segment two-syllable words: silent e, vowel team, r-controlled

what_to_do.en: Tap the two parts of the long word.

stages.choice_rule: Four choices. Each choice is the same target word with one hyphen and the letters kept in order. Exactly one choice is the real two-part split. Tier 1 wrong splits are easy chops or cuts inside the pattern. Tier 2 wrong splits slide the hyphen by one letter. Tier 3 wrong splits sit one or two letters from the real break.

roots: Give four hyphen splits of the same word, with every letter kept in order.
Exactly one choice is the real two-part split. The other three are wrong.
The right silent-e split keeps the whole silent-e chunk, as in cup-cake or bed-time.
The right vowel-team split keeps each team inside one part, as in rain-bow or pea-nut.
The right r-controlled split keeps r with its vowel and breaks between the two consonants.
For a double letter plus a vowel team, break between the doubles and keep the team together.
Tier 1 wrong splits are easy to spot. Tier 3 wrong splits sit only one or two letters from the real hyphen.
Use explain_key silent_e, vowel_team, r_controlled, double_team, or r_and_silent_e.
Each stem has only one two-syllable target from home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather.
Never use sound symbols, brand names, or a real child name. A name slot must be <NAME>.
A final silent e after r stays in the last part, and r stays with its vowel, as in tur-tle.

tier_rules.1: The stem is one familiar two-syllable word. The right split is an obvious two-beat break. Wrong splits chop off one letter or cut inside a team, an r, or a silent e.
tier_rules.2: The stem is a short kid sentence with one two-syllable word. Wrong splits slide the hyphen by one letter.
tier_rules.3: The stem is a longer kid sentence. Wrong splits are near misses that divide double letters the wrong way, pull r off its vowel, or leave a silent e behind.

silent_e.en: Keep the silent-e part whole. The e stays with its vowel.
silent_e.ko: 묵음 e 부분은 통째로 둡니다. e는 그 모음과 함께 있습니다.

vowel_team.en: Say the two real parts. Keep each vowel team inside its part.
vowel_team.ko: 진짜 두 부분으로 말하세요. 모음 팀은 각 부분 안에 둡니다.

r_controlled.en: Keep r with its vowel, and split between the two consonants.
r_controlled.ko: r은 모음과 함께 둡니다. 자음 둘 사이를 나눕니다.

double_team.en: Split between the double letters, and keep the vowel team together.
double_team.ko: 같은 자음 둘 사이를 나눕니다. 모음 팀은 한 부분에 둡니다.

r_and_silent_e.en: Keep r with its vowel, and keep the silent e in the last part.
r_and_silent_e.ko: r은 모음과 함께 둡니다. 묵음 e는 끝 부분에 둡니다.
